## TL;DR

Task #1059 adds a **docs/bookkeeping-only fast path** for `repoos check`, handoff, and close-out. When every path in the branch-vs-base diff is on a conservative allowlist (`work/**`, `docs/**`, `user-docs/**`, `inputs/**`, `schedules/**`, or any `*.md` outside `src/`, `scripts/`, and `tests/`), the gate runs repository guards only (format, lockfile sync, zero-runtime-deps, task-assets, task parser) and skips build, tests, browser checks, and remote validation, logging `docs/bookkeeping-only diff: full suite skipped`. Classification is centralized in `src/core/check-docs-only.ts`, overridable via `check.docsOnlySkip` (default on, Settings → Advanced). Any git failure to list changed paths, any disallowed path, or `docsOnlySkip = false` keeps the full gate—fail closed.

## Work and rationale

The pain case was weekly worktree cleanup and similar chores: diffs that touch only `work/` reports or task markdown still queued remote validation and ran hundreds of Vitest files, wasting runner time without touching behavior. The fix had to be **conservative** (never treat `src/**`, manifests, lockfiles, or `repoos.toml` as safe), **shared** across CLI self-check, server handoff, and Move-to-done validation, and **documented** so operators know when the shortcut applies.

**Classification (`isDocsOnlyCheck`)** lives in a tiny core module with a single user-visible reason string. Paths are normalized (slashes, `./` prefix); traversal segments fail closed. Explicit denylists cover `src/`, `scripts/`, `tests/`, `.githooks/`, and lock/manifest basenames anywhere in the tree (so `docs/bun.lock` does not qualify). Allowed paths are prefix-based directories plus any `.md` file not under denied trees—matching the task spec without widening to arbitrary extensions under `docs/`.

**CLI (`cmdCheck` / `runCheckPlan`)** computes `changedPaths` the same way as scoped `--changed main`, then sets `docsOnly` when classification passes and the profile is not `release`. `runCheckPlan` skips every step whose `kind` is not one of the four cheap guards, attaches the skip reason to each skipped step, and appends a synthetic `task-parser` step (full `buildIndex` over `work/`). Staleness, lint, build, tests, UI smoke, and contrast steps are skipped with the shared message. Remote pre-review is suppressed when `docsOnly` is true (`shouldRunCliRemotePreReviewGate` is not consulted). Release profile never takes the shortcut.

**Handoff** reuses branch merge-base resolution and `getChangedFilePaths`. On a docs-only diff it logs the skip reason to task logs and the check handle, leaves `remoteOutcome` as skip, and does not call `runRemotePreReviewGate`—addressing the acceptance criterion that bookkeeping handoffs should not wait for a remote slot.

**Close-out (`integration-orchestrator`)** classifies the merged candidate diff the same way. `gatePlan` is null for docs-only closes (no scoped/full suite replanning), candidate prebuild is skipped when the plan has a build step, and remote validation on close-out is gated off. Existing bookkeeping drift logic (#0637, #0355) remains separate; this path is about the **task branch content** being non-behavioral.

**Configuration** adds `check.docsOnlySkip` to defaults (`true`), TOML parsing (with legacy `checks.docsOnlySkip` alias), `getConfigSchema()`, supported-keys list, and a Settings Advanced toggle tested in `settings-location.test.ts` and `isolation-runs-config.test.ts`. No `repoos.toml` edit was required to ship defaults.

**Tests** cover the classifier table (`check-docs-only.test.ts`), plan runner guard/skip/binary failure (`check-runner.test.ts` docs-only describe), handoff without remote validator invocation (`handoff.test.ts`), config schema, and existing close-out docs-fast-path suites still align for empty merge diffs.

**Docs** update `user-docs/check.md` and `user-docs/configuration.md` with the rule and toggle; `docs/close-out-pipeline.md` notes the fast path in the gate section.

## Approaches tried

The implementation follows the task's latest direction: **code-owned allowlist** with optional config disable, not a `repoos.toml` plan fork. An earlier task draft mentioned editing `[[check.steps]]`; that was rejected here to avoid landing friction (`repoos.toml` edits block close-out) and to keep one predicate shared by CLI and server.

`runCheckPlan` was chosen as the single skip implementation so handoff/close-out subprocess `repoos check` invocations behave identically to the CLI without duplicating step lists. Task-parser runs as an extra step only in docs-only mode because it is not a named `kind` in the default plan but remains a required guard per AGENTS.md.

Release and `--profile release` intentionally bypass docs-only so tagged releases always exercise the full suite.

## Challenges and blockers

Aligning **handoff reuse** with docs-only: a reused check from a prior commit must not accidentally skip remote validation when the new diff is not docs-only; the existing reuse predicate runs before docs-only remote suppression, and only non-reused non-docs-only paths enter remote validation.

**Lint in docs-only mode**: only format among fmt/lint guards is in the keep list per spec ("format check on touched files"); lint is skipped with the shared reason like build/tests—consistent with "cheap guards" wording but worth noting for reviewers who expect both fmt and lint.

This task's own branch touches `src/**`, so **self-check still runs the full gate including remote validation**; the fast path is validated by unit/integration tests rather than this task's handoff diff.

## Key learnings

Bookkeeping-only classification belongs in **core** next to other shared gate predicates (`check-skip.ts`, drift helpers), not buried in `check.ts`, so server code never drifts from CLI rules.

Failing closed on `null` changed paths reuses the same signal git errors already produce—no new failure mode.

Operator visibility matters: one stable log line (`DOCS_ONLY_SKIP_REASON`) threads through console output, task logs, skip step details, and close-out integration logs so support can grep a single string.

The shortcut complements—not replaces—**check reuse** and **close-out gate modes**: a docs-only branch can still benefit from reuse if the tree is unchanged; close-out merge/conflict hygiene is unchanged.
